note: Floors for the retrieval-and-citation gate, set from the measured run (golden set version 2, baseline v0). A change ships only if no metric drops below these. citationsReturned is the number of hits agents receive across all searches, so a change that quietly returns fewer results fails here. When a change improves a metric, raise the floor in the same change so the gain cannot be lost later; the test does not check that. Never lower a floor to make a change pass.
